results.title: Naqvi directs measures to expedite immigration process at Lahore airport
results.description: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi on Sunday paid a surprise visit to Allama Iqbal International Airport and reviewed the immigration process and facilities for passengers. During the visit, the minister inspected immigration counters and asked staff about the procedures and issues faced by passengers. He also spoke to passengers about the time taken for immigration clearance. Passengers told the minister that the process was taking around 30 minutes and called for further improvement in arrangements. Taking notice of their concerns, Mohsin Naqvi directed officials to expedite the immigration process and keep all immigration counters operational to avoid unnecessary delays. A passenger also complained about an agent allegedly demanding money. The minister took notice of the complaint, referred the matter to the FIA Director and directed that the agent be arrested. Mohsin Naqvi said passengers with incomplete travel documents would not be allowed to travel, while those possessing complete documents would not be stopped from travelling. He said modern technology had made the immigration process easier, while strict action was being taken against those attempting to travel on fake documents.

results.title: Israel Warns Citizens in Greece as Gaza Genocide Protests Target Tourist Sites
results.description: Israel's Foreign Ministry has warned its citizens in Greece to conceal Jewish symbols ahead of pro-Palestinian protests explicitly framed as opposition to the Gaza genocide. The advisory comes as Israel announced 627 new West Bank settlement units on the same day.

results.title: Saudi landmarks shine in Saudi, Türkish and Pakistani colors to celebrate Makkah pact
results.description: Major landmarks and towers across Saudi Arabia are illuminated with the national flags of Saudi Arabia, Türkiye, and Pakistan to celebrate the signing of the Makkah Joint Defense Agreement. The illumination displays across various regions reflected widespread public jubilation over the historic pact. The agreement embodies the three nations’ shared commitment to strengthening their collective security, achieving peace and stability in the Middle East and globally, and striving for a secure and prosperous future. These celebrations underscore the distinguished relations, deep-rooted historical ties, and Islamic solidarity uniting Saudi Arabia, Türkiye, and Pakistan. The landmark defense agreement builds upon these bonds of brotherhood, driven by shared strategic interests and a unified commitment to close military cooperation.

results.title: Kharge, Rahul Gandhi Extend Greetings To Indian Youth Congress On Foundation Day
results.description: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, Rahul Gandhi and K C Venugopal extended greetings to Indian Youth Congress members on the organisation’s Foundation Day. Leaders highlighted the IYC’s role in raising youth concerns, promoting young leadership and providing a platform for public service. The Indian Youth Congress was founded on August 9, 1960, as the youth wing of the Congress party.
